texts: Whenever a Keeper marries a member of a fisher family, that Keeper keeps the station.

fields.sentence: Whenever a Keeper marries a member of a fisher family, that Keeper keeps the station.
parse: (: keeper_marry_rule (Implication (And (Member $k keeper) (Member $e marry) (Agent $e $k) (Theme $e $m) (Member $f fisher_family) (PartOf $m $f)) (And (Member (sk_keep $e) keep) (Agent (sk_keep $e) $k) (Theme (sk_keep $e) sk_station_1) (During (sk_keep $e) $e))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Follows the whenever/every-time template exactly — plain-variable premises, a Skolem consequent event keyed to the trigger event, the During link, top-level typing for the definite station, and no QuantifierPhrase companion. 'A member of a fisher family' takes the bare PartOf encoding the instruction set's own 'every member of the committee' example uses, and 'that Keeper' correctly resolves to the rule variable.
